stem: Which pair of emergency conditions is explicitly signposted for separate review in the Emergency Medicine section?
explanation: Foreign body aspiration and anaphylaxis are the correct pair because they are the emergency conditions explicitly signposted for separate review.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Respiratory 3.1 Acute Respiratory Problems

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because asthma and bronchiolitis are not the pair explicitly signposted for separate review.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because foreign body aspiration and anaphylaxis are the emergency conditions explicitly signposted for separate review.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because pneumonia and pleural effusion are not the pair explicitly signposted for separate review.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because cystic fibrosis and bronchiectasis are not the pair explicitly signposted for separate review.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because tuberculosis and pertussis are not the pair explicitly signposted for separate review.
